numbering: Episodes numbered continuously from 1 to 193, with The Final Act counted as episodes 168-193 (animefillerlist.com numbering).

arcs.name: The Shattered Jewel
arcs.summary: Schoolgirl Kagome is pulled down a well into feudal Japan, where she frees a half-demon named Inuyasha from a 50-year seal. When the Shikon Jewel is shattered, the two reluctantly team up to recover its shards.
events: Kagome accidentally shatters the Shikon Jewel with an arrow, scattering shards across the land.
Inuyasha's elder half-brother Sesshomaru fights him over their father's sword, Tessaiga.
The fox-demon child Shippo joins the group after the Thunder Brothers kill his father.

arcs.name: Kikyo's Revival and Naraku
arcs.summary: The priestess Kikyo, who sealed Inuyasha, returns in a clay body, and the lecherous monk Miroku joins the hunt. A schemer named Naraku is revealed as the one who set Inuyasha and Kikyo against each other.
events: Inuyasha's human night under the new moon is revealed.
The witch Urasue resurrects Kikyo, who still believes Inuyasha betrayed her.
Miroku, cursed with a Wind Tunnel in his hand by Naraku, joins the party.
Naraku is revealed to be born from the bandit Onigumo, who coveted Kikyo fifty years ago.

arcs.name: Sango and Naraku's Castle
arcs.summary: Demon slayer Sango is manipulated into attacking Inuyasha after her village is wiped out. The group storms Naraku's castle while Kikyo wanders on her own path.
events: Sango learns Naraku massacred her clan and controls her little brother Kohaku.
Sango and her cat-demon Kirara join Inuyasha's group.
Sesshomaru's Tenseiga and Inuyasha's Tessaiga are revealed to be twin swords that refuse to fight each other.

arcs.name: Koga and Kagura
arcs.summary: The wolf-demon leader Koga kidnaps Kagome for her ability to sense shards, and Naraku begins spawning incarnations of his own.
events: Koga declares Kagome his woman, sparking a rivalry with Inuyasha.
Naraku's incarnations Kagura and Kanna make their debut.
The demon Goshinki snaps Tessaiga, and Inuyasha transforms into a full demon.
The rogue swordsmith Kaijinbo forges an evil sword for Sesshomaru from Goshinki's fangs.

arcs.name: Tokijin and Ryukotsusei
arcs.summary: Sesshomaru takes up a cursed blade while Naraku continues to plot through his offspring. Inuyasha's demon blood grows dangerous whenever Tessaiga leaves his side.
events: Sesshomaru masters the demonic sword Tokijin.
Kohaku's memories are erased, keeping him as Naraku's puppet.
Inuyasha faces Ryukotsusei, the dragon who sealed his father, and learns the Backlash Wave.

arcs.name: Tsubaki and Naraku's Barrier
arcs.summary: A dark priestess with a grudge against Kikyo is hired by Naraku, and the group searches for a way through Naraku's barrier.
events: The dark priestess Tsubaki curses Kagome with a shikigami spell.
Kagura considers rebelling against Naraku to win her freedom.
Muso, a demon holding Onigumo's discarded human heart, resurfaces.
Tessaiga gains the red barrier-breaking form by absorbing a bat demon's power.

arcs.name: Panther Demon Tribe
arcs.summary: An anime-only story in which four panther demon generals seek revenge on the sons of the Inu no Taisho.
events: The Panther Demon Tribe's Four Generals target both Sesshomaru and Inuyasha.
The brothers end up fighting a common enemy to stop the panther lord's revival.

arcs.name: Naraku's Whereabouts and Ayame
arcs.summary: Rin is kidnapped to lure Sesshomaru while Naraku goes into hiding. A young wolf-demon girl shows up claiming Koga promised to marry her.
events: Kagura and Kanna kidnap Rin to bait Sesshomaru.
Ayame of the northern wolf tribe chases Koga to collect his marriage promise.
Kikyo continues her lonely journey hunting Naraku.

arcs.name: Filler Stretch and the Jewel Maker
arcs.summary: A run of mostly standalone adventures, including the tale of the priestess Midoriko who created the Shikon Jewel.
events: Kagome's brother Sota confesses to a girl at school.
The group investigates the legend of the Shikon Jewel's creation.
Kikyo and Kagome are trapped together in a cave.

arcs.name: Band of Seven and Mount Hakurei
arcs.summary: Naraku revives a band of seven notorious mercenaries with jewel shards, while he hides inside the sacred barrier of Mount Hakurei.
events: The Band of Seven are resurrected and attack the wolf tribe and Inuyasha's group.
Miroku is poisoned by Mukotsu and Inuyasha fights the mechanical Ginkotsu.
Inuyasha kills Jakotsu, and Bankotsu falls after absorbing his comrades' shards.

arcs.name: Naraku Reborn
arcs.summary: Naraku emerges from Mount Hakurei with a new body, and his reach into Kagome's and Kikyo's lives grows darker.
events: Naraku is reborn and strikes Kikyo down with his miasma.
Inuyasha grieves Kikyo, believing her gone.
Kagome battles her own jealousy and resolves to stay by Inuyasha's side.

arcs.name: Hakudoshi and Entei
arcs.summary: Naraku splits off a powerful infant and its child-like guardian, Hakudoshi, as new fears and side adventures crowd the journey.
events: The group fights dried-up demons at Kagome's school festival.
Miroku's master Mushin's past and the monk's own reckless confession are explored.
Hakudoshi tames the fire-horse demon Entei.

arcs.name: The Father's Grave and Princess Abi
arcs.summary: Inuyasha and Sesshomaru head for their father's grave in search of a hidden shard, while a bird princess gathers blood for her mother.
events: The group travels to the Inu no Taisho's resting place in the afterlife border.
The jewel-keeping demon Hosenki and his diamond pearl hold a key to a new Tessaiga technique.
Princess Abi's bird demons harvest human blood for Naraku.

arcs.name: The Saint and Moryomaru
arcs.summary: Naraku hides his heart in the infant and builds a giant armored demon, Moryomaru, to hold it.
events: Tessaiga learns the Adamant Barrage by absorbing Hosenki's diamond power.
Sesshomaru and Inuyasha clash again at their father's grave.
Kohaku chooses to stay with Kikyo and aid her hunt for Naraku.

arcs.name: End of the Original Series
arcs.summary: The first anime run winds down with character pieces and a renewed push against Naraku before going on hiatus.
events: Miroku's past philandering comes back to haunt him.
Shippo is possessed by a parasite.
Inuyasha and Kikyo cooperate, using a jewel shard as bait against Naraku.

arcs.name: Naraku's Heart
arcs.summary: The story picks up where the manga diverged from the first anime, as the hunt for Naraku's hidden heart reaches its climax.
events: Kagura is freed of Naraku's grip and dies peacefully with Sesshomaru beside her.
Inuyasha learns Dragon-Scale Tessaiga to cut demonic auras.
Sesshomaru's own sword Bakusaiga awakens, and Moryomaru is destroyed and reabsorbed by Naraku.

arcs.name: Meido and Kanna's End
arcs.summary: Sesshomaru pursues mastery of the Meido Zangetsuha, which reveals hard truths about his father's intentions for both sons.
events: Sesshomaru enters the underworld to save Rin, learning the limits of Tenseiga.
Tenseiga's Meido Zangetsuha is passed on to Inuyasha's Tessaiga.
Kikyo is fatally wounded and dies in Inuyasha's arms.
Kanna sacrifices herself in an attempt to kill Kagome.

arcs.name: Magatsuhi
arcs.summary: The evil spirit dwelling in the Shikon Jewel takes form, and Kagome's long-sealed spiritual power becomes the key.
events: The jewel's malevolent spirit Magatsuhi possesses Kohaku's body.
Kagome's sealed spiritual power is freed.
Sesshomaru battles Magatsuhi and drives it out of Kohaku.

arcs.name: The Final Battle
arcs.summary: Naraku completes the jewel and draws everyone into his body for a last confrontation.
events: Kohaku's life-sustaining shard ties his survival to Kikyo's last light.
Inuyasha and allies destroy Naraku from within.
Kagome wishes the jewel away forever and is sent back to her own time.
Three years later Kagome returns through the well to stay with Inuyasha.

filler.note: Filler is scattered standalone episodes plus the Panther Demon Tribe arc (75-79) and the long 89-101 stretch; The Final Act has no filler.
